newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco gets nod to list 26.1 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Uraco gets nod to list 26.1 mln new shares.

text.p: Uraco Holdings Ltd has received in-principle approval from the Stock Exchange of Singapore to list 26.1 million new ordinary shares of S$0.10 each.
A DBS Bank statement issued on behalf of Uraco said on Friday the listing of the new shares was in connection with its 51 percent acquisition of U.S. precision machine-maker Longs Manufacturing Inc.
In July, Uraco announced it had agreed to buy into the U.S. firm for US$17.96 million.
Uraco is an aluminium die-casting and precision machining manufacturer. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
